Class AgiClassLoader

java.lang.Object
java.lang.ClassLoader
java.security.SecureClassLoader
java.net.URLClassLoader
uno.anahata.asi.toolkit.java.AgiClassLoader
All Implemented Interfaces:
Closeable, AutoCloseable
public class AgiClassLoader extends URLClassLoader
A session-scoped URLClassLoader that maintains identity and holds in-memory compiled classes (AgiCompiledClass) across turns for an AGI session.

Serving as the parent classloader for ephemeral script loaders (such as Java.AnahataClassLoader), AgiClassLoader ensures that classes compiled via Java.compile(String, String, String, String[], Path) are defined exactly once in the session metaspace. This completely eliminates ClassCastException when instantiating compiled types in one turn and casting them in subsequent turns (e.g. via sessionMap).

anahata

    • loadClass

      protected Class<?> loadClass(String name, boolean resolve) throws ClassNotFoundException
      Implements session-scoped classloading:
      1. Returns previously loaded classes (guaranteeing single-instance identity).
      2. Delegates parent-first infrastructure classes to the host loader.
      3. Defines in-memory compiled bytecode from active AgiCompiledClasses in Java.
      4. Searches child-first URLs for libraries supplied in extra classpath.
      5. Falls back to the host parent classloader.
      6. Queries toolkit fallback bytes and extra sibling classloaders (e.g. JavaFX).
      Overrides:
      loadClass in class ClassLoader
      Parameters:
      name - the binary name of the class.
      resolve - if true, resolves the class.
      Returns:
      the resulting Class object.
      Throws:
      ClassNotFoundException - if the class cannot be found.
